title: ADVANCING RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION FOR PERSIAN: DEVELOPMENT OF LANGUAGE MODELS, COMPREHENSIVE BENCHMARKS, AND BEST PRACTICES FOR OPTIMIZATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical optimization and benchmarking of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for the Persian language using general, scientific, and organizational policy datasets. While it mentions that religious books were part of the pretraining corpus and religious texts were included in fine-tuning, the research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study.
